scenarios.prompt: Give our work group today's AI framework trends; the direct chat belongs to a personal creator.
expectations: Uses the work group's notebook and excludes private personal context.
Includes dated source links and states unavailable engagement metrics.

scenarios.prompt: Write five punchy tweets. I have not supplied any personal results.
expectations: Drafts original short opinions without invented personal experiences.
Does not publish or automatically follow anyone.

scenarios.prompt: X search is unavailable. Prepare the daily brief anyway.
expectations: Uses public web fallback and labels the coverage limitation.
Gives evidence-backed ideas without fake X post links or metrics.
